nodes.label: AI-DLC Method Import Stub
nodes.rationale: A reference, never a copy: the layered method (org/team/project plus the four phase files) is authored once under the workspace memory tree, and this stub pulls it into ambient context so casual chat outside a stage still sees standing practices. Claude imports name one explicit file each (no globs), resolve relative to this file, and chain up to four hops, so a new method file needs a matching import line. Ships pointed at the always-present default space; /aidlc space <name> re-points these lines in place, a byte-identical no-op at default. AI-DLC's own stage resolver reads the same tree directly and never needs the stub.
